nodes.description: Immutable address of the logic (implementation) contract; target of delegatecall in both constructor and fallback.
Constructor(address _logic, bytes _initializationCalldata): stores logic and delegatecalls into it with arbitrary initialization calldata, reverting with the returned reason on failure.
Payable fallback() that forwards all calldata to the logic contract via inline-assembly delegatecall and returns/reverts with the raw return data.
Constructor parameter _logic: address written to the immutable 'logic' state variable and used as delegatecall target.
Constructor parameter _initializationCalldata: arbitrary bytes supplied to the initial delegatecall.
Local bool _ok holding the success flag returned by the constructor delegatecall.
Local bytes returnData holding the revert/return payload of the constructor delegatecall.
_logic.delegatecall(_initializationCalldata): delegatecall with attacker-influenceable calldata executed in the context of this proxy.
Inline-assembly delegatecall(gas(), _impl, ptr, calldatasize(), 0, 0) in the fallback: forwards arbitrary calldata to the logic contract.
Local address _impl in the fallback, loaded from the state variable 'logic' and used as the delegatecall destination.
Free-memory pointer used by the assembly block to copy calldata, return data and revert payloads.

edges.reason: The constructor body performs the initialization delegatecall.
Constructor parameter _logic is assigned to the immutable state variable logic.
Constructor parameter _logic is the address on which delegatecall is invoked.
Caller-supplied _initializationCalldata is passed verbatim as delegatecall payload, executing arbitrary logic code in the proxy context.
Success flag of the delegatecall is captured in local _ok and checked by require.
Return data of the delegatecall is captured in local returnData and used as the revert reason.
The fallback body performs the assembly delegatecall.
The fallback declares and initializes the local _impl before delegating.
State variable logic is read into local _impl.
Local _impl is the target address of the assembly delegatecall.
The fallback assembly block uses ptr for calldatacopy/returndatacopy buffers.
Delegatecall result data is written to and returned/reverted from the memory region pointed to by ptr.

normalization_plan.reason: _logic is a constructor argument used only to initialize the immutable logic state variable and to select the delegatecall target; it can be collapsed into the constructor core node.
_initializationCalldata is supplied directly as the payload of the constructor delegatecall and has no independent identity.
_ok is only the transient success flag of the delegatecall and is immediately consumed by require.
returnData is only the transient revert payload of the delegatecall used as the require message.
_impl is a single-use copy of the logic state variable feeding the fallback delegatecall.
ptr is an assembly scratch buffer pointer used exclusively by the fallback delegatecall block.
